project.name: LoL-Tracker
project.summary: Team analytics tracker for League five-stacks: automatic Flex 5 and weekend Ranked 5v5 tracking, MVP/team scores, team leaderboards across EUW, EUNE, NA, BR and KR, AI analytics and coach chat, scrim import, plus a Draft Battle game and a LoLDex collection of pros and streamers.
project.pricing: Freemium: Free forever (1 team, last 6 months, 24 h refresh cooldown, no card); Tryhard USD/EUR 4.99 per month or 49.99 per year; Pro USD/EUR 12.99 per month or 129.99 per year (5 teams, 2 years history, AI analysis, AI coach chat, scrims).

about.text: Team analytics tracker for League five-stacks: automatic Flex 5 and weekend Ranked 5v5 tracking, MVP/team scores, team leaderboards across EUW, EUNE, NA, BR and KR, AI analytics and coach chat, scrim import, plus a Draft Battle game and a LoLDex collection of pros and streamers.

pricing.text: Freemium: Free forever (1 team, last 6 months, 24 h refresh cooldown, no card); Tryhard USD/EUR 4.99 per month or 49.99 per year; Pro USD/EUR 12.99 per month or 129.99 per year (5 teams, 2 years history, AI analysis, AI coach chat, scrims).

data_sources.text: Imports Riot queue data (Flex 5, weekend Ranked 5v5 queue 710) for linked accounts; scrims are imported custom games.

coverage.text: Team leaderboard regions: EUW, EUNE, NA, BR, KR; Ranked 5v5 (queue 710) imported alongside Flex; leaderboard uses Flex 5 games only.
